metadata.desc: Large elegant white display serif title at the top center of the cover. Decorative swash flourishes extend from the letters. Bold upright letterforms with high contrast against the dark background.

Figure in theatrical Renaissance-inspired high-fashion costume, waist-up. Smooth matte white porcelain mask with small dark circular eye holes and neutral melancholy expression. Antique-gold sculpted floral crown headpiece with off-white draped veil flowing over the shoulders. Dark black textured bodice with intricate gold embroidery and a large gold tassel pendant at the chest center. Extremely voluminous deep red silk ruffled sleeves. One gloved hand raised near the face in a delicate theatrical gesture.
